# Development Tasks

This project uses [mise] to manage development tools and run common tasks. Mise ensures everyone uses the same tool
versions and provides convenient commands for formatting and linting.

If you prefer not to use mise, all tasks have equivalent shell scripts in the `scripts/` directory.

## `generate:aur`

Generate AUR PKGBUILD for a release

- **Usage**: `generate:aur [--version <version>] [--sha256 <sha256>]`

### Flags

#### `--version <version>`

Package version without leading v (e.g. 2026.5.18-beta.1)

#### `--sha256 <sha256>`

Binary tarball SHA256 checksum

## `generate:flatpak`

Generate Flatpak manifest and metadata for a release

- **Usage**: `generate:flatpak [FLAGS]`

### Flags

#### `--url <url>`

Binary tarball download URL (for remote source)

#### `--sha256 <sha256>`

Binary tarball SHA256 checksum (for remote source)

#### `--path <path>`

Local binary tarball path relative to flatpak/ dir (for CI builds)

## `generate:item-images`

Fetch 64px icons for all published item types into the committed asset set

- **Usage**: `generate:item-images [FLAGS]`

### Flags

#### `--ids <ids>`

Space-separated type IDs to fetch instead of the full SDE set (verification mode)

#### `--concurrency <n>`

Number of parallel fetch workers (default 16)

#### `--out <dir>`

Output directory (default assets/images/items)

#### `--min-coverage <pct>`

Minimum percent of published types that must resolve before a full-SDE run is a success (default 95)
